description: Evidence-backed blessed tuning overlays and operator playbook for 10, 50, and 200 plus pane fleets. These profiles are intended for controlled operation and diagnostics, not as a claim that the finish-line release gates are green.

profiles.name: fleet_10
profiles.objective: Prefer low-latency capture and fast operator feedback on small local swarms.
profiles.support_posture: Blessed for day-to-day use. Changes remain bounded by the release-gate contract and should be rolled back on repeated warning-tier diagnostics.
escalation: If health.ingest_lag_max_ms stays above 5000 for three checks, move back to default config and follow docs/operator-playbook.md.
If health.backpressure_tier reaches Red or Black, stop local tuning and capture doctor/status artifacts before retrying.

profiles.name: fleet_50
profiles.objective: Match the verified 50-pane soak class while keeping the default runtime shape recognizable to operators.
profiles.support_posture: This is the baseline blessed profile because the 50-pane soak lane is part of the passing ft-xbnl0.4.5 matrix.
escalation: If queue depth grows across three checks without recovering, step back to default config or fleet_10 before attempting more tuning.
If leak or doctor surfaces degrade, stop at this profile and wait for ft-xbnl0.4.4 evidence to be green before promoting further.

profiles.name: fleet_200_plus
profiles.objective: Bias for stability, bounded queue growth, and diagnostics visibility during large-fleet runs.
profiles.support_posture: Blessed only for controlled operation. The 200-pane release soak exercised the required backpressure tier but still exceeded the 3.0s duration budget, so this profile is not a release-promotion claim.
escalation: If health.backpressure_tier reaches Black outside planned stress windows, stop the run and capture status plus doctor bundles immediately.
If release-gate duration or leak evidence regresses, keep this profile in operator-only mode and do not roll it into a final closure recommendation.
